en.name: Aadhaar Enrolment & Update
en.description: 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to residents of India, based on demographic and biometric data. Used as proof of identity and address and as a KYC token across government and private services.
en.eligibility: Any resident of India (including infants) irrespective of citizenship status of parents for enrolment; updates available to existing holders.
en.benefits: Single portable ID accepted nationwide; enables DBT, subsidy linkage, KYC, and access to many government schemes.
application_steps: Locate nearest Aadhaar enrolment centre / Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
Fill enrolment/update form and submit supporting documents.
Collect acknowledgement slip with Enrolment ID (EID).
Download e-Aadhaar once UID is generated (verify on uidai.gov.in).
faqs: Is Aadhaar mandatory for all schemes?
How do I enrol for Aadhaar?
How do I update my address in Aadhaar?
